topic: Introduce a Person You Find Truly Beautiful(介绍一个你认为真正美的人)
title_en: The Most Beautiful Person I Know
genre: 人物介绍 / 短文(introduce a person + explain why, using subject clauses)
source: 外研社选择性必修三 Unit 1 Using language & Presenting ideas:用主语从句介绍人物(What impresses me most is…;It is clear that…;Whoever … )。围绕'真正的美'主题。
prompt_cn: 本单元的主题是'真正的美'。请用英语写一篇约80词的短文,介绍一个你认为'真正美'的人(可以是家人、朋友或你敬佩的人),内容包括:① 简单说明他/她是谁;② 用具体事例说明你为什么觉得他/她美;③ 谈谈他/她让你学到了什么。要求:至少用三个主语从句(如 What impresses me most is… / It is true that… / Whoever …),句子地道、围绕中心。
prompt_en: The theme of this unit is true beauty. Write a short passage (about 80 words) introducing a person you think is truly beautiful (a family member, a friend or someone you admire). Include: 1) who the person is; 2) why you find them beautiful, with an example; 3) what they have taught you. Use at least three subject clauses (e.g. What impresses me most is…, It is true that…, Whoever…).
points: 说明人物是谁(The person I admire most is …)
用主语从句讲为什么美(What impresses me most is …)
用形式主语 it 补充观点(It is clear that …)
谈收获、句句围绕'真正的美'这一中心
model_essay: The most beautiful person I know is my grandmother. What impresses me most is not her face but her kindness. Whoever meets her feels welcome at once, because she listens with a warm and honest heart. It is true that her hair is grey and her hands are rough, yet everyone says she shines. What she taught me is simple: real beauty comes from how we treat others. Whether we are young or old, that gentle kind of beauty never fades away.
model_translation: 我认识的最美的人是我的奶奶。最打动我的不是她的容貌,而是她的善良。无论谁见到她,都立刻感到被欢迎,因为她用温暖而真诚的心倾听。的确,她头发花白、双手粗糙,但人人都说她在发光。她教给我的道理很简单:真正的美源自我们如何待人。无论年轻还是年老,那种温柔的美永不褪色。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:人物是谁 / 为何美(有事例)/ 学到什么
围绕'真正的美'展开、句句相关、至少三个主语从句运用自然、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、主语从句(what/that/whether/it/whoever)运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 点题人物 The most beautiful person I know is …
主语从句讲原因 What impresses me most is …
形式主语 it It is true that …
收获升华 What she taught me is that real beauty comes from …
key_expressions: What impresses me most is not her face but her kindness.
Whoever meets her feels welcome at once.
It is true that her hair is grey, yet everyone says she shines.
What she taught me is that real beauty comes from how we treat others.

high_sentences: What impresses me most is not her face but her kindness.
Whoever meets her feels welcome at once.
It is true that her hair is grey, yet everyone says she shines.
Whether we are young or old, that gentle beauty never fades away.

error_pairs.wrong: What impresses me most are her kindness.
error_pairs.correct: What impresses me most is her kindness.
error_pairs.note: what 引导的主语从句作主语时,谓语动词通常用单数 is。

error_pairs.wrong: Is important that we value inner beauty.
error_pairs.correct: It is important that we value inner beauty.
error_pairs.note: 主语从句后置,句首必须用形式主语 it。

error_pairs.wrong: If we should care about looks is hard to say.
error_pairs.correct: Whether we should care about looks is hard to say.
error_pairs.note: 句首主语从句表'是否'用 whether,不用 if。

paragraph_template:
【真正的美·人物介绍结构】

第2-3句 原因+事例:What impresses me most is … Whoever … because …
第4句 形式主语补充:It is true that … , yet …
第5句 收获升华:What she taught me is that real beauty comes from …
